policy: NFC, Unicode default full case folding, NFC; accent-sensitive binary ordering of resulting UTF-8 keys
storage: Original filenames and artifact IDs are unchanged. Comparison keys are transient. Equivalent names remain separate records under distinct IDs; no overwrite, merge or persisted index migration. Existing ID-collision errors remain authoritative.
offlineBuild: Use the checksum-verified module cache also required for the existing Go dependencies. No runtime network lookup or table download. TestUnicodeComparisonPolicy rejects a toolchain change selecting different Unicode tables.
